svg.title: Several histories, a shared place
svg.desc: Three imagined histories meet in Amsterdam. Its red street impression overlaps black drawings of the Los Angeles, Pasadena and Long Beach areas.
svg.metadata: Illustrative histories. Real OpenStreetMap street geometry, independently fitted. Authored connecting gestures. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Artwork by Kumma Wu.
